name: Finish My Drawing
description: Start a drawing, pass it on twice, then see what it became at the gallery reveal.

intro.message:
FINISH MY DRAWING!

Start a drawing, anything you like. Then it passes to a classmate who has to keep it going. Twice. You won't know what yours became until the gallery.

start-drawing.prompt: Start a drawing, anything at all. Someone else will finish it!

continue-1.prompt: You've inherited a classmate's drawing. Keep it going, add to it, don't scribble it out!

continue-2.prompt: One more pass! Finish this drawing, final touches, background, a title character, whatever it needs.

check.template: Review the finished drawings below, then open the gallery.

gallery.message: Three artists each, here's what your drawings became!

end.message: That's Finish My Drawing! Every picture up there had three artists.
